title: Russian: Cyrillic Alphabet
description: For beginners learning all 33 Russian letters, with sound cues and 33 example words. Romanization is a reading aid, not exact pronunciation; stress and vowel reduction affect speech.

sources.name: Original explanations based on standard Russian orthography

cards.back: a: Usually ah as in father when stressed; often reduced when unstressed.
cards.example: Это арбуз. (This is a watermelon.)

cards.back: arbuz: watermelon. Contains А а; letter transliteration: a.
cards.example: Это арбуз. (This is a watermelon.)
cards.hint: Identify the letters, then recall the English meaning.

cards.back: b: Like b in book; often devoiced to p at a word end.
cards.example: Это банк. (This is a bank.)

cards.back: bank: bank. Contains Б б; letter transliteration: b.
cards.example: Это банк. (This is a bank.)
cards.hint: Identify the letters, then recall the English meaning.

cards.back: v: Like v in very; often devoiced to f at a word end.
cards.example: Вода здесь. (The water is here.)

cards.back: voda: water. Contains В в; letter transliteration: v.
cards.example: Вода здесь. (The water is here.)
cards.hint: Identify the letters, then recall the English meaning.

cards.back: g: Usually hard g as in go.
cards.example: Там гора. (There is a mountain over there.)

cards.back: gora: mountain. Contains Г г; letter transliteration: g.
cards.example: Там гора. (There is a mountain over there.)
cards.hint: Identify the letters, then recall the English meaning.

cards.back: d: Like d in dog; often devoiced to t at a word end.
cards.example: Это наш дом. (This is our house.)

cards.back: dom: house. Contains Д д; letter transliteration: d.
cards.example: Это наш дом. (This is our house.)
cards.hint: Identify the letters, then recall the English meaning.

cards.back: ye/e: Often ye at a word start; after a consonant, usually e and softens the consonant.
cards.example: Там ель. (There is a spruce over there.)

cards.back: yel': spruce. Contains Е е; letter transliteration: ye/e.
cards.example: Там ель. (There is a spruce over there.)
cards.hint: Identify the letters, then recall the English meaning.

cards.back: yo: Yo at a word start; after a consonant, usually o and softens the consonant. Normally stressed.
cards.example: Вот ёлка. (Here is a fir tree.)

cards.back: yolka: fir tree. Contains Ё ё; letter transliteration: yo.
cards.example: Вот ёлка. (Here is a fir tree.)
cards.hint: Identify the letters, then recall the English meaning.

cards.back: zh: Like the sound in measure, but with the tongue farther back; normally hard.
cards.example: Это жук. (This is a beetle.)

cards.back: zhuk: beetle. Contains Ж ж; letter transliteration: zh.
cards.example: Это жук. (This is a beetle.)
cards.hint: Identify the letters, then recall the English meaning.

cards.back: z: Like z in zoo; often devoiced to s at a word end.
cards.example: У меня болит зуб. (My tooth hurts.)

cards.back: zub: tooth. Contains З з; letter transliteration: z.
cards.example: У меня болит зуб. (My tooth hurts.)
cards.hint: Identify the letters, then recall the English meaning.

cards.back: i: Similar to ee in see; usually softens a preceding consonant.
cards.example: Это игра. (This is a game.)

cards.back: igra: game. Contains И и; letter transliteration: i.
cards.example: Это игра. (This is a game.)
cards.hint: Identify the letters, then recall the English meaning.

cards.back: y: A short glide like y in yes; not a full vowel.
cards.example: Я ем йогурт. (I am eating yogurt.)

cards.back: yogurt: yogurt. Contains Й й; letter transliteration: y.
cards.example: Я ем йогурт. (I am eating yogurt.)
cards.hint: Identify the letters, then recall the English meaning.

cards.back: k: Like k in skin, with little aspiration.
cards.example: Кот спит. (The cat is sleeping.)

cards.back: kot: cat. Contains К к; letter transliteration: k.
cards.example: Кот спит. (The cat is sleeping.)
cards.hint: Identify the letters, then recall the English meaning.

cards.back: l: An l sound; hard and soft versions differ in tongue position.
cards.example: Лампа на столе. (The lamp is on the table.)

cards.back: lampa: lamp. Contains Л л; letter transliteration: l.
cards.example: Лампа на столе. (The lamp is on the table.)
cards.hint: Identify the letters, then recall the English meaning.

cards.back: m: Like m in mother.
cards.example: Мама дома. (Mom is at home.)

cards.back: mama: mother. Contains М м; letter transliteration: m.
cards.example: Мама дома. (Mom is at home.)
cards.hint: Identify the letters, then recall the English meaning.

cards.back: n: Like n in no.
cards.example: У меня холодный нос. (My nose is cold.)

cards.back: nos: nose. Contains Н н; letter transliteration: n.
cards.example: У меня холодный нос. (My nose is cold.)
cards.hint: Identify the letters, then recall the English meaning.

cards.back: o: Usually o when stressed; often reduced toward ah when unstressed.
cards.example: Окно открыто. (The window is open.)

cards.back: okno: window. Contains О о; letter transliteration: o.
cards.example: Окно открыто. (The window is open.)
cards.hint: Identify the letters, then recall the English meaning.

cards.back: p: Like p in spin, with little aspiration.
cards.example: Это парк. (This is a park.)

cards.back: park: park. Contains П п; letter transliteration: p.
cards.example: Это парк. (This is a park.)
cards.hint: Identify the letters, then recall the English meaning.

cards.back: r: A tapped or trilled r made with the tongue tip.
cards.example: Это моя рука. (This is my hand.)

cards.back: ruka: hand; arm. Contains Р р; letter transliteration: r.
cards.example: Это моя рука. (This is my hand.)
cards.hint: Identify the letters, then recall the English meaning.

cards.back: s: Like s in see.
cards.example: Я пью сок. (I am drinking juice.)

cards.back: sok: juice. Contains С с; letter transliteration: s.
cards.example: Я пью сок. (I am drinking juice.)
cards.hint: Identify the letters, then recall the English meaning.

cards.back: t: A dental t, with the tongue near the upper teeth.
cards.example: Он там. (He is there.)

cards.back: tam: there. Contains Т т; letter transliteration: t.
cards.example: Он там. (He is there.)
cards.hint: Identify the letters, then recall the English meaning.

cards.back: u: Similar to oo in food.
cards.example: Доброе утро! (Good morning!)

cards.back: utro: morning. Contains У у; letter transliteration: u.
cards.example: Доброе утро! (Good morning!)
cards.hint: Identify the letters, then recall the English meaning.

cards.back: f: Like f in fine.
cards.example: Это моё фото. (This is my photo.)

cards.back: foto: photo. Contains Ф ф; letter transliteration: f.
cards.example: Это моё фото. (This is my photo.)
cards.hint: Identify the letters, then recall the English meaning.

cards.back: kh: A voiceless throat sound like ch in Scottish loch.
cards.example: Я ем хлеб. (I am eating bread.)

cards.back: khleb: bread. Contains Х х; letter transliteration: kh.
cards.example: Я ем хлеб. (I am eating bread.)
cards.hint: Identify the letters, then recall the English meaning.

cards.back: ts: Like ts in cats, pronounced as one consonant.
cards.example: Это цирк. (This is a circus.)

cards.back: tsirk: circus. Contains Ц ц; letter transliteration: ts.
cards.example: Это цирк. (This is a circus.)
cards.hint: Identify the letters, then recall the English meaning.

cards.back: ch: Similar to ch in cheese; normally soft.
cards.example: Я пью чай. (I am drinking tea.)

cards.back: chay: tea. Contains Ч ч; letter transliteration: ch.
cards.example: Я пью чай. (I am drinking tea.)
cards.hint: Identify the letters, then recall the English meaning.

cards.back: sh: Like sh in ship, but with the tongue farther back; normally hard.
cards.example: Это красный шар. (This is a red ball.)

cards.back: shar: ball; sphere. Contains Ш ш; letter transliteration: sh.
cards.example: Это красный шар. (This is a red ball.)
cards.hint: Identify the letters, then recall the English meaning.

cards.back: shch: A long soft sh-like sound in standard modern Russian; shch is a conventional transliteration.
cards.example: Это щука. (This is a pike.)

cards.back: shchuka: pike, a fish. Contains Щ щ; letter transliteration: shch.
cards.example: Это щука. (This is a pike.)
cards.hint: Identify the letters, then recall the English meaning.

cards.back: hard sign: No sound of its own; separates a preceding consonant from a following iotated vowel.
cards.example: Это важный объект. (This is an important object.)

cards.back: obyekt: object. Contains Ъ ъ; letter transliteration: hard sign.
cards.example: Это важный объект. (This is an important object.)
cards.hint: Identify the letters, then recall the English meaning.

cards.back: y: A vowel made farther back than ee; no exact English equivalent.
cards.example: Я ем сыр. (I am eating cheese.)

cards.back: syr: cheese. Contains Ы ы; letter transliteration: y.
cards.example: Я ем сыр. (I am eating cheese.)
cards.hint: Identify the letters, then recall the English meaning.

cards.back: soft sign: No sound of its own; often marks a soft consonant and can act as a separator.
cards.example: Где соль? (Where is the salt?)

cards.back: sol': salt. Contains Ь ь; letter transliteration: soft sign.
cards.example: Где соль? (Where is the salt?)
cards.hint: Identify the letters, then recall the English meaning.

cards.back: e: Similar to e in bet; generally does not soften the preceding consonant.
cards.example: Я слышу эхо. (I hear an echo.)

cards.back: ekho: echo. Contains Э э; letter transliteration: e.
cards.example: Я слышу эхо. (I hear an echo.)
cards.hint: Identify the letters, then recall the English meaning.

cards.back: yu: Yu at a word start; after a consonant, usually u and softens the consonant.
cards.example: Это моя юбка. (This is my skirt.)

cards.back: yubka: skirt. Contains Ю ю; letter transliteration: yu.
cards.example: Это моя юбка. (This is my skirt.)
cards.hint: Identify the letters, then recall the English meaning.

cards.back: ya: Ya at a word start; after a consonant, usually a and softens the consonant.
cards.example: Я ем яблоко. (I am eating an apple.)

cards.back: yabloko: apple. Contains Я я; letter transliteration: ya.
cards.example: Я ем яблоко. (I am eating an apple.)
cards.hint: Identify the letters, then recall the English meaning.
